title: MoonAtlas claims
description: What one Researcher agent learned about one area: each claim cites where it is true and names where it is written.

subject.description: The module, class, function, file or concept the claim is about, by its name in the code.

cites.description: Repo-relative path:line, path:start-end, or a markdown page path#anchor.

home.description: Where the claim is already written: a docs page, a code comment, or nowhere.

gap_home.description: When home is none: the page#section or file where it belongs.

notes.description: What was skipped or left uncertain, and why.
